meta.name: keyword-cluster-architect
meta.description: Map 50-200+ keywords into topical clusters for SEO domination. Build content roadmaps for topical authority. Triggers on: "keyword research", "keyword clustering", "topical authority", "keyword map", "keyword strategy", "content roadmap for SEO", "keyword grouping", "topic clusters", "SEO keyword plan", "map my keywords", "keyword cluster", "hub and spoke content", "build topical authority", "SEO content plan", "keyword universe".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将关键词聚类生成SEO内容路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望通过关键词聚类建立主题权威，提升搜索排名
copy.tagline_en: Cluster keywords into topical groups for SEO content roadmaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build topical authority and dominate search results through keyword clustering

howto.what: Claude 会将 50-200+ 个关键词按搜索意图分组为主题簇，并规划出以中心内容为骨干、支线内容为分支的内容路线图，用于指导 SEO 内容创作。
howto.when: 当你提到“关键词研究”、“关键词聚类”、“主题权威”、“SEO 关键词计划”、“内容路线图”等词汇，或要求对大量关键词进行整理时触发。
